MANCHESTER, OFFICE BASED

Get Recruited is partnering with an established facilities management business to recruit an HR and Office Manager for its Manchester head office.

Supporting a business who has employees across the North West, this HR and Office Manager position has a strong emphasis on office management, administration and coordination, alongside practical HR responsibilities.

It will operate a licensing regime; set corporate governance standards and monitor, protect, and promote financial resilience. It will also enforce compliance with requirements on financial regulation, club ownership and directors, fan engagement, and heritage protection.

- Maintain effective collaboration between the IFR and key football competition authorities, including the Premier League, EFL and National League.
- Work closely with colleagues at all levels, representing the Director's Office and helping to drive departmental priorities.
- Build strong working relationships with senior leaders across the Supervision Directorate and the wider organisation.
- Manage complex and sensitive issues relating to regulated clubs and corporate matters, while delivering high-quality reporting, briefings and governance support.

Essential Requirements
- The ability to work at pace, driving progress in the face of a range of competing views and being calm and resilient in pressurised situations.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and pressure.
- Strategic thinking to understand the sensitivities of the brief and spot the key issues and risks before they arise.
- Leadership skills and ability to form effective working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders internally and externally, and at various levels of seniority.

- Knowledge of the football industry.

title: Document Controller
description:
Document Controller

Facade Remediation Contractor

Location: Manchester City Centre - Office-based, with occasional travel to project sites
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Contract: Full-time, permanent

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and highly organised Document Controller to join a growing facade remediation contractor.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the delivery of our facade remediation projects, ensuring that all project documentation is accurately controlled, maintained and distributed. Working closely with project managers, site teams, commercial teams, consultants and subcontractors, you will be responsible for maintaining robust document control procedures and ensuring that project information is managed efficiently throughout the project lifecycle.

Previous experience using Viewpoint 4 Projects is essential for this role. We are looking for someone who can confidently manage construction documentation within the platform and understands the importance of accurate revision control, document tracking and maintaining comprehensive project records.

This is an office-based position, with occasional travel to project sites as required.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain project documentation through Viewpoint 4 Projects, ensuring all information is correctly uploaded, recorded, distributed and controlled.
- Maintain document registers, drawing registers, revision histories and transmittal records across multiple projects.
- Ensure the correct and latest revisions of drawings, specifications and technical documents are available to relevant project stakeholders.
- Upload, issue and track drawings, technical submissions, specifications, reports, risk assessments and method statements.
- Monitor document review and approval workflows, following up with project teams, consultants and subcontractors on outstanding submissions.
- Maintain accurate records of quality assurance documentation, inspection and test records, photographic evidence and project compliance information.
- Assist with the preparation and collation of project handover packs, operation and maintenance manuals, health and safety files and completion documentation.
- Support the management of facade remediation documentation, including material approvals, product data, fire safety information and other relevant compliance records.
- Liaise with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure project information is issued and received within agreed timescales.
- Ensure document control procedures are consistently followed and project records remain accurate, organised and accessible.
- Provide general administrative and document management support to project delivery teams.
- Travel to project sites when required to support document control and project administration activities.

Essential Requirements
- Proven experience working as a Document Controller within the construction industry.
- Essential: hands-on experience using Viewpoint 4 Projects.
- Strong understanding of construction document control procedures and revision management.
- Experience managing technical drawings, document registers and project information across multiple projects.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Excellent organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail.
- Strong communication skills and the confidence to liaise with project teams, consultants and subcontractors.
- A proactive approach to managing deadlines, chasing outstanding information and resolving document-related issues.
- The ability to work independently in an office-based environment while supporting multiple project teams.
- Flexibility to travel to project sites when required.

Desirable Experience
- Experience working for a facade contractor, remediation contractor or main contractor.
- Exposure to cladding replacement, external wall systems, fire safety remediation or building refurbishment projects.
- Experience managing quality assurance records, compliance documentation and project handover information.
- An understanding of the documentation requirements associated with building safety and facade remediation works.

Salary and Benefits

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, including:
- Discretionary annual bonus
- Private healthcare
- Annual salary reviews
- Company pension scheme
- 25 days' annual holiday, plus bank holidays

How to Apply

If you are an experienced Document Controller with a strong working knowledge of Viewpoint 4 Projects and are looking to join a growing facade remediation business, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your CV, outlining your relevant construction experience and experience using Viewpoint 4 Projects, to insert contact details .

We are looking for someone who takes pride in maintaining accurate project records, works proactively with project teams and understands the importance of effective document control in delivering successful remediation projects.

title: Document Controller
description:
The Opportunity

We are working with a well-established construction and development business delivering large-scale residential projects, who are looking to appoint an experienced Document Controller / Information Management professional to join their team.

This is a technical Document Control position, with a strong emphasis on digital systems, information management, document workflows and software.

We are not looking for a traditional administration-focused Document Controller. The successful candidate will need to have substantial hands-on experience managing project information through digital platforms and be confident in implementing, managing and improving document control processes.

Construction experience is useful, but strong software and document control experience is the priority.

The Role

You will be responsible for managing project information throughout the construction lifecycle, ensuring information is correctly controlled, structured, distributed and maintained.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing all project documentation through Viewpoint for Projects (VfP), including naming conventions, version control and structured filing.
- Managing site-based information capture through Field View.
- Controlling document workflows, reviews, approvals and transmittals.
- Ensuring project information complies with agreed protocols and information management standards.
- Monitoring document workflows and outstanding submissions to ensure information is available when required.
- Producing reports covering document status, overdue actions, compliance and information management.
- Supporting project audits, quality checks and handover documentation.
- Providing guidance, training and day-to-day support to project teams using document control systems.
- Working closely with project managers, site teams, consultants, subcontractors and clients to maintain effective information flow.
- Helping to develop and improve digital document control processes across projects.
- Maintaining data integrity, confidentiality and consistent information management practices.

About You

We are looking for someone who has genuine technical Document Control / Information Management experience, rather than someone whose background is predominantly general administration.

You should have:
- Strong experience using Viewpoint for Projects (VfP) essential.
- Excellent understanding of document control processes, workflows and version control.
- Strong IT and digital systems capability.
- Experience working with CDEs / information management platforms.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
- A good understanding of ISO 19650 information management principles.
- Experience managing documentation across complex projects or multiple stakeholders.
- Confidence supporting and training colleagues in the use of digital systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to information management.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work with multidisciplinary project teams.

Experience with Field View would be highly desirable, along with exposure to other CDE platforms such as SharePoint, Asite or Aconex.

Important

This is not a traditional administration role.

The successful candidate will need to demonstrate substantial hands-on experience with document control software, CDEs, digital information management and document workflows.

We would consider candidates from outside the construction sector where they can demonstrate the required level of technical Document Control and Information Management experience.

If you are an experienced Document Controller, Information Manager, Document Management Specialist or CDE Specialist with strong technical software experience and are looking for an opportunity to take ownership of information management within a growing construction business, we would like to hear from you.
